01 /Applied machine learning

Looking closer at synthetic media.

Bringing image and audio classification into an approachable web interface, alongside a dedicated Vision Transformer training workflow.

Code↗How it works↓
01

Project focus

Media processing, model integration, and a reproducible path from fine-tuning to evaluation.

  • Django
  • PyTorch
  • TensorFlow
  • Vision Transformer
  • Librosa
01

The problem

A detection model is only one part of the experience. Users also need a simple way to submit media and understand the prediction, while developers need a separate workflow to train and evaluate the model.

02

How it comes together

  1. 01

    Upload

    Django views accept image or audio files through dedicated forms.

  2. 02

    Prepare

    Images are resized and normalized; audio becomes a mel spectrogram.

  3. 03

    Infer

    TensorFlow and PyTorch models handle the two media paths.

  4. 04

    Present

    The interface displays the predicted label and model score.

My contribution

  • Connected media upload, preprocessing, and inference within the web application.
  • Added a Vision Transformer fine-tuning pipeline with class-weighted loss and checkpoint selection.
  • Separated model evaluation into a script reporting precision, recall, F1, and a classification report.
03

The result

The project connects two detection workflows in one application and includes a separate ViT experiment pipeline. The code makes both the user-facing prediction flow and the model-development process available to explore.
